title: Prove COPY power floor for row-masked P112 basis switches
body:
For any two P112 coordinates, any fixed invertible complex 2-by-2 basis, and any subset of the 112 source rows, switching to the dual basis on that subset cannot lower the separate COPY bill. The sharp rank-sum floor is **64**; the stronger power floor is **8 * 8^theta for every 0 < theta <= 1**.

The proof routes sixteen balanced independent units through the old or new term according to the row mask. The 308 certificates cover all 28 coordinate pairs and 11 complex support strata, so the written argument handles every mask without enumerating 2^112 subsets. Both added source columns can leave the root code; an exact rank-ten fixture confirms that boundary.

Only `research/p112-row-mask-basis-switch/` is added. This settles one common-mask subfamily of Philipp/mightyOil's PR1197 coupled rank-two opening. Arbitrary source corrections remain open. PR1689 uses complementary Walsh masks and arbitrary real reader coefficients, a different family. The selected result and frozen sources remain unchanged; **no new kappa, physical supplier, or original 5% construction-gate success is claimed**.

## Evidence

Exact contribution head: `bde435de6beeceaf3028a7cdcc7cf3b8cc331545`, base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-row-mask-basis-switch
```

Passed on CPython 3.12.12, macOS arm64:

- All 308 balanced certificates / 1,232 independent groups; 42 exact endpoint fixtures check 526,848 changed-block entries.
- Separate Euclidean-root/full-column/set-elimination replay agrees on every certificate; 17,472 Gaussian-coefficient support controls pass. It imports no primary or predecessor code, but shares certificate witnesses and row ordering.
- Ten primary controls/boundary checks, three independent controls, and five regression groups: dependence, missing cases, incorrect support, ordinary-transpose errors, numeric aliases, source/receipt corruption, deterministic generation and optimized read-only relocation.
- Both checkers pass from a read-only Git export of the exact committed head. Direct optimized Python 3.14.6 checks and tests pass; the registered launcher correctly requires its declared Python 3.12.
- `make selected-record-check` and staged whitespace checks pass. Full selected cold replay, native/hosting and dirty-workspace admission, precision/tape, analytic transfer, Lean and human proof review are unclaimed. Hosted CI is separate.

## Scope and credit

One revision-3 draw, nonce `b753af53242f8a79a9032531c8f15c54`, selected complex mechanisms. TASK explicitly declares the change from physical rank-shape synthesis and one narrowing from arbitrary sources to a common row mask. [Discussion1737](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1737) records the claim and handoff. Final overlap at 08:28–08:30 UTC covered 421 open PRs and 379 Discussion records with complete pagination/no warnings, plus local packages and ledger; it is not a novelty guarantee.

Credit Mihir Srivastava/PR845 for geometry and the single-lift model, woklerx/PR998 for its complex extension, Philipp/mightyOil/PR1197 for the two-total opening and basis-cost warning, DreamingOfClouds/PR717/446 and GamingPuzzled/PR620 for the COPY interface/baseline, and the additional predecessor/selected-construction lineage retained in the README. All consumed bytes and historical sources are pinned.

Prepared for **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in mathematics, both implementations, tests and prose. No subagents or independent human review. Apache-2.0.

The next bounded experiment is a fixed sum/difference reader pair with source supports that cannot be written as one common mask of the dual basis, followed by the complete four-term bill. The present routing proof does not apply there.
